name: Knife
description: A compact close-quarters blade suited to tight spaces, quick draws, and general utility use.
narrative_effects: Supports discreet melee actions in tight spaces where larger weapons are awkward.

name: Dagger
description: A balanced short blade designed for close fighting, fast strikes, and easy carry.
narrative_effects: Supports rapid close-quarters stabbing and defensive knife work.

name: Hand Axe
description: A compact axe suited to close fighting, harsh utility work, and brutal short-range strikes.
narrative_effects: Supports tight-quarters chopping attacks and rough field utility where a small axe is practical.

name: Brass Knuckles
description: A compact fist reinforcement favored in brawls and dirty close combat.
narrative_effects: Supports brutal close-in striking where fists alone would be less effective.

name: Clawed Gauntlet
description: A fitted gauntlet with hardened claw-like projections for tearing strikes and vicious clinch fighting.
narrative_effects: Supports raking, tearing, and close-control fighting with an overtly vicious style.

name: Club
description: A basic striking weapon that relies on force and simplicity rather than refinement.
narrative_effects: Supports straightforward blunt-force attacks with minimal technical complexity.

name: Mace
description: A one-handed crushing weapon built to deliver punishing impact through armor and guard.
narrative_effects: Supports crushing blows against guarded or armored targets.

name: War Hammer
description: A compact battlefield hammer designed for focused, forceful impact.
narrative_effects: Supports concentrated armor-breaking or guard-crushing melee strikes.

name: Shortsword
description: A shorter battlefield sword suited to disciplined close combat and compact fighting lines.
narrative_effects: Supports disciplined cutting and thrusting in close melee without the reach of a full sword.

name: Sword
description: A standard full-length sword built for decisive battlefield or dueling use.
narrative_effects: Supports versatile melee offense with strong cultural and martial legitimacy.

name: Axe
description: A full-sized combat axe built for committed chopping strikes and heavy momentum.
narrative_effects: Supports forceful cutting attacks that emphasize commitment and impact.

name: Greataxe
description: A heavy two-handed axe built for devastating committed swings.
narrative_effects: Supports brutal high-commitment strikes that trade speed for impact.

name: Greatsword
description: A large two-handed sword meant for powerful sweeping offense and battlefield dominance.
narrative_effects: Supports broad, forceful blade work with heavy striking presence.

name: Spear
description: A versatile pole weapon built for thrusting, spacing, and disciplined line fighting.
narrative_effects: Supports thrusting attacks that capitalize on distance and controlled engagement.

name: War Staff
description: A reinforced fighting staff suited to spacing, leverage, and defensive control.
narrative_effects: Supports measured striking, interception, and spacing control in melee.

name: Polearm
description: A general battlefield polearm designed for line control, distance, and leverage.
narrative_effects: Supports battlefield spacing and punishing attacks before foes can close.

name: Halberd
description: A complex polearm combining thrusting reach with chopping and hooking threat.
narrative_effects: Supports mixed reach fighting with hooking, chopping, and positional control.

name: Pike
description: A long formation spear meant to keep enemies at distance and punish frontal advance.
narrative_effects: Supports extended-distance thrusting and anti-charge battlefield framing.

name: Shortbow
description: A compact bow suited to mobile shooting and practical field use.
narrative_effects: Supports flexible ranged attacks with moderate power and easier handling.

name: Longbow
description: A powerful bow built for distance, discipline, and precision at range.
narrative_effects: Supports longer-range shooting with stronger battlefield presence than a shortbow.

name: Sling
description: A simple ranged weapon using stones or similar projectiles through practiced release.
narrative_effects: Supports low-cost ranged harassment where stones or sling ammo are available.

name: Throwing Knife
description: A balanced knife intended for short-range thrown attacks.
narrative_effects: Supports quick thrown attacks at short distance with light easily carried weapons.

name: Javelin
description: A light throwing spear designed for forceful ranged delivery.
narrative_effects: Supports strong thrown attacks with more force and reach than smaller thrown weapons.

name: Light Crossbow
description: A mechanically assisted ranged weapon that favors stability over rate of fire.
narrative_effects: Supports controlled ranged fire with mechanical draw power rather than bow technique.

name: Heavy Crossbow
description: A heavier mechanically assisted ranged weapon built for punishing power at the cost of speed.
narrative_effects: Supports slow, forceful mechanical ranged attacks with strong impact.

name: Whip
description: A flexible weapon used more for control, reach tricks, and intimidation than straightforward damage.
narrative_effects: Supports unconventional control, disorientation, or spacing tactics depending on context.

name: Net (weapon use)
description: A thrown restraint tool used in combat to entangle and control rather than injure.
narrative_effects: Supports entangling, restraining, or disrupting movement instead of direct weapon damage.

name: Blowgun
description: A subtle projectile weapon suited to quiet delivery over force.
narrative_effects: Supports discreet ranged delivery where stealth or toxin use matters more than raw damage.

name: Chain (weapon use)
description: A weighted chain used offensively through momentum, entanglement, and difficult angles of attack.
narrative_effects: Supports entangling, whipping, and otherwise irregular attacks that depend on context and handling.
